name: Rougoku no Misleat ~Fukushuu no In'yaku Choukyou~
original_name: 牢獄のミスリート～復讐の淫薬調教～
source:
The story revolves around the evil syndicate Dozma, which operates across the entire universe and is organized under the legendary space pirate emperor, Grand Chief Atlandamnack, and his seven top executives. A power struggle ensues among these executives to select a new leader. Afurshaat F. Misleet rises to power, overshadowing another candidate, Hoffman. 

Misleet, the first female chief, receives a mission from Atlandamnack to secretly mine a rare metal vein on Earth, a planet technologically lagging behind. Despite initially underestimating the task, Misleet progresses by exploiting Earth's inhabitants. 

Unexpectedly, she is apprehended by rookie space detective Fio, leading to a revelation about an unknown man orchestrating events from the shadows, seeking revenge against Misleet. The mysterious man, codenamed "Wooden Face", harbors a deep grudge after losing everything to Misleet in the past.

[Condensed from the [url=https://www.lilith-soft.com/index.php/black/product41]official site[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕邪恶集团多兹玛展开。该组织横跨整个宇宙，由传奇宇宙海贼皇帝大首领亚特兰达姆纳克及其麾下7名最高干部统领。干部之间爆发权力斗争，以选出新的领袖。阿芙尔夏特·F·米斯莉特崛起掌权，压过另一名候选人霍夫曼。

作为首位女性首领，米斯莉特接受亚特兰达姆纳克的任务，前往科技落后的地球秘密开采一条稀有金属矿脉。她起初轻视任务，随后通过利用地球居民推动计划。

出人意料的是，她被新手宇宙侦探菲奥逮捕。事件由此揭示，有一名身份不明的男子正在暗中操纵一切，企图向米斯莉特复仇。代号“木脸”的神秘男子曾因米斯莉特失去一切，对她怀有深切仇恨。
